images.subject: 30mm-exterior
images.credit: U.S. Air Force / Staff Sgt. Rachel Williams
images.rights: DVIDS identifies public domain; comply with linked DVIDS visual-information restrictions. No endorsement implied.
images.inspection_method: Downloaded original public preview and inspected using view_image; no generated/retouched reference images.
observed: Single dark gun tube, enlarged cylindrical muzzle sleeve with visible oblong side vents, and open dark bore.
Large circular dark flexible boot inside a riveted fuselage surround; peripheral angular fairing visible.
External gun silhouette is primarily tube and muzzle; receiver/feed machinery is not a large free-standing exterior turret.
limitations: Oblique frontal photograph does not provide orthographic dimensions, travel limits or exact mount position on this game airframe.
Do not infer identical W pressure-boot geometry from this J image.

images.subject: exterior-firing-smoke
images.credit: U.S. Air Force / Tech. Sgt. Manuel J. Martinez
images.rights: DVIDS identifies public domain; comply with linked DVIDS visual-information restrictions. No endorsement implied.
images.inspection_method: Downloaded original public preview and inspected using view_image; no generated/retouched reference images.
observed: A gray/white diffuse smoke puff trails the port lower fuselage during firing.
No large persistent rocket-like flame is visible in this photographed moment.
limitations: Earlier W event does not establish the later 105-mm fit.
One photograph cannot determine flash duration, color in all lighting or true firing cadence.

claims.claim: Both selected families use side-firing single-barrel 30-mm and 105-mm installations; no rotary Gatling barrel is supported for these candidate configurations.
30-mm spent cases collect inside fabric bags; 105-mm spent cases remain inside and are handled/stacked.
The earlier 105-mm gun and the upgraded Gun Aircraft Unit must not be silently blended.
claims.decision: Use circa-2021 legacy installation; upgraded 2022+ appearance remains separate future option.

claims.claim: Two EO/IR installations are part of the relevant family equipment, but exact J sensor identity depends on configuration.
claims.decision: Label authored MX-20-family form as representative until exact tail/block/slot is accepted; never substitute generic MTS appearance based solely on C-130 family.

authored_assumptions: Mechanism travel, timing, visual-only projectile path, case fall path, FX intensity and detailed mounting coordinates are artist-authored and remain non-certified.
No guidance, targeting, ballistic effectiveness, fire-control system or real weapon construction is part of this reference work.
W and J exterior pressure boots, sensor models and installation offsets require tail-specific acceptance; common caliber alone is not interchangeability evidence.
